decision: Recorded the training-loop mechanics that explain Stage9395: safety and EOS/generation cap are fixed, train rows overfit, heldout suffix support remains the active blocker.

active_training_loop_mechanics.checkpoint_safety: no final checkpoint export, skip final model save, cleanup proof emitted
active_training_loop_mechanics.evaluation: eval and strict_eval run under no_grad with separate loss records
active_training_loop_mechanics.generation_audit: greedy generation with active prefix field, exact/prefix/boundary/contentful/short/repetition/leak checks
active_training_loop_mechanics.gradient_clipping: clip_grad_norm_ max_norm=1.0 and log pre/post clip norms
active_training_loop_mechanics.loss_masking: row loss masks select denoise_ce only for current probes; decoder_ce remains closed
active_training_loop_mechanics.optimizer: AdamW over model parameters with fixed tiny-probe learning rate
active_training_loop_mechanics.post_prefix_loss_mask: denoise probes mask prefix tokens and train only post-prefix suffix targets

next_patch_contract.pass_gate: strict exact, prefix, boundary, contentful all 23/23 with short/junk/repetition/leak/unterminated rows all zero before rejoining bounded decoder repair
required_audits: generation cap >= observed target token max plus EOS margin
next_patch_contract.required_rows: add train support rows for failing eval/strict suffix families without copying heldout row IDs or exact target text into model input

not_yet_scale_features.checkpoint_resume: disabled for safety probes; only reintroduce under safe checkpoint contract
not_yet_scale_features.distributed_training: not relevant until compiler produces scaled manifests
not_yet_scale_features.gradient_accumulation: not required for tiny 23-row probes; add before large batches
not_yet_scale_features.mixed_precision_bf16: not required for current probe; add only behind determinism/NaN guards
not_yet_scale_features.optimizer_param_groups: current AdamW uses all params together; add no-decay groups before longer runs

metrics.stage9395_diagnosis: Train rows overfit exactly after target resolver and generation-cap fixes, but eval/strict rows remain weak. The next blocker is heldout suffix support/generalization, not safety, EOS clipping, leaks, repetition, or decoder CE.

name: stage9396_training_loop_frontier_diagnosis_contract
next_best_step: Build a heldout contrastive suffix-support manifest with family-balanced train support for eval/strict suffix failures; keep decoder CE closed.
